outcome: admission rates due to suspected preterm labor
cohort: 342 women with a history of singleton spontaneous preterm birth (sPTB) due to premature contractions (PMC) or preterm premature rupture of membranes (pPROM) who had a subsequent pregnancy.
finding: 17P treatment significantly prolonged the subsequent pregnancy duration (by 4.3w in the PMC group and 3.7w in the pPROM group) compared to non-treatment, potentially decreasing premature delivery complications.
gest_age: Previous sPTB deliveries occurred at 33.4 weeks vs. 35.3 weeks in the PMC group and 34.1 weeks vs. 35.7 weeks in the pPROM group; the study measured the prolongation of subsequent pregnancies.
